bottles.name: Macallan Ruby
bottles.about: Part of Macallan's 1824 Series, which graded whisky by natural colour rather than age. Ruby was the darkest of the range, matured entirely in sherry-seasoned casks. It has since been discontinued and is now quite hard to find.

bottles.name: Rosebank 13 Old Malt Cask
bottles.notes: Douglas Laing Old Malt Cask; cask 224, 1 of 211; distilled Jan 1990, bottled Jun 2003
bottles.about: Rosebank, at Falkirk, was the classic Lowland distillery: triple-distilled and famously light and floral. It fell silent in 1993, which made bottlings like this one much sought after. This single cask yielded just 211 bottles, distilled in January 1990 and bottled in June 2003. The distillery was rebuilt and began distilling again in 2023.

bottles.name: SMWS 87.3 Millburn
bottles.notes: Millburn (closed distillery); distilled Oct 1983, bottled Jun 1996
bottles.about: Millburn was one of three Inverness distilleries, all lost in the closures of the 1980s; its buildings later became a restaurant. In the Society's code, 87 stands for Millburn and this was its third cask, distilled in October 1983 and bottled in June 1996. Bottles from closed distilleries like this rarely come up now.

bottles.name: Moray Glen 14
bottles.about: Bottled by Macallan to commemorate the 100th Moray Open in July 2005, the amateur golf tournament held at Moray Golf Club in Lossiemouth. The label carries a portrait of Old Tom Morris, the great Victorian golfer who laid out the club's Old Course.

bottles.name: Glenfarclas
bottles.about: Glenfarclas has been owned and run by the Grant family since 1865, one of very few Speyside distilleries still independent. Its direct-fired stills and sherry casks give a rich, traditional style.

bottles.name: Johnnie Walker Blue Label
bottles.cask: Blend of rare malt and grain whiskies
bottles.about: Johnnie Walker's flagship blend, built from rare reserves. The firm traces its roots to John Walker's grocery in Kilmarnock in 1820.

bottles.name: GlenDronach Parliament
bottles.cask: Oloroso and Pedro Ximénez sherry casks
bottles.about: GlenDronach is known for its deeply sherried Highland malts. 'Parliament' is named for the colony of rooks – a parliament – that nests in the trees above the distillery.

bottles.name: Bunnahabhain 25 Boisdale
bottles.notes: Single cask, Boisdale 25th Anniversary, 1 of 300; distilled 20/10/1989, bottled 2015
bottles.about: Bunnahabhain is the gentle, mostly unpeated face of Islay. This single cask, distilled on 20 October 1989 and bottled in 2015, was chosen to mark the 25th anniversary of Boisdale, the London restaurant and whisky bar group. Only 300 bottles were filled.

bottles.name: Copper Monument (Ardmore) 2010
bottles.about: Ardmore in Aberdeenshire is one of the few Highland distilleries known for peated spirit. This is an independent single-cask bottling of 2010 spirit at seven years old.

bottles.name: Tomatin
bottles.cask: Bourbon casks, finished in oloroso sherry
bottles.about: Tomatin, south of Inverness, was once the largest malt distillery in Scotland. Its 18 year old is finished in oloroso sherry butts.

bottles.name: Edradour Cask Strength
bottles.about: Edradour, near Pitlochry, was long known as one of the smallest traditional distilleries in Scotland. It has been owned by independent bottler Signatory since 2002, and its Natural Cask Strength releases come in this distinctive decanter.

bottles.name: Highland Park "Rebus 30"
bottles.about: A limited release marking 30 years of Ian Rankin's Inspector Rebus novels, a whisky lover's detective. Highland Park, in Kirkwall on Orkney, uses aromatic Orkney peat in its malt.

bottles.name: Glenfarclas 105
bottles.about: First released in 1968, the 105 was one of the earliest cask-strength single malts. The name comes from its strength: 105° British proof, or 60% ABV.

bottles.name: Glen Deveron Burgh of Macduff
bottles.about: Glen Deveron is the name under which Macduff distillery's single malt is bottled. The 16 year old belongs to its Royal Burgh Collection.

bottles.name: Glen Deveron (boxed)
bottles.about: Glen Deveron is the name under which Macduff distillery's single malt is bottled. The 16 year old belongs to its Royal Burgh Collection.

bottles.name: Glengoyne 17 Lang Brothers
bottles.about: An older bottling from the Lang Brothers era, before Ian Macleod bought the distillery in 2003. Glengoyne sits right on the Highland Line and uses unpeated, air-dried barley.

bottles.name: Macallan Fine Oak
bottles.cask: Sherry-seasoned European and American oak, plus bourbon casks
bottles.palate: Smooth, dried fruit, gentle oak spice
bottles.about: The Fine Oak range, introduced in 2004, added bourbon casks to Macallan's sherry-oak recipe for a lighter style. It was replaced in 2018 by the Triple Cask range.

bottles.name: Ardnamurchan AD/02.22 Cask Strength
bottles.cask: Bourbon and sherry casks, peated and unpeated spirit
bottles.about: Ardnamurchan, on the remote west-coast peninsula of the same name, is run by independent bottler Adelphi and powered by local renewable energy. The AD/ code gives the month and year of bottling – February 2022 here.

bottles.name: Glenlivet 12 All Malt
bottles.about: An older 75cl bottling from before the move to 70cl. 'Unblended All Malt' was how single malts were often described before the term became standard.

bottles.name: Springbank
bottles.about: Springbank is one of Scotland's oldest family-owned distilleries and floor-malts all its own barley. Its spirit is distilled two and a half times, and it is a cult favourite.

bottles.name: Hazelburn
bottles.about: Hazelburn is Springbank's unpeated, triple-distilled malt, named after a lost Campbeltown distillery. It is the gentlest of the distillery's three styles.

bottles.name: Craigellachie Old Fashioned
bottles.about: Craigellachie still uses worm-tub condensers, which give a famously weighty, almost meaty spirit. The 13 year old leads its core range.

bottles.name: Aberlour Casg Annamh
bottles.about: Casg Annamh is Gaelic for 'rare cask'. Each small batch marries whisky from different cask types.

bottles.name: Aultmore Foggie Moss
bottles.about: Aultmore takes its water from the Foggie Moss, a peat-covered area of the hills near Keith. For many years almost all of its whisky went into blends.

bottles.name: Deanston
bottles.cask: Finished in Bordeaux red wine casks
bottles.about: Deanston sits on the River Teith in a converted 18th-century cotton mill and runs on its own hydro-electric power. This 10 year old is finished in Bordeaux red wine casks.

bottles.name: Glenfiddich IPA Experiment
bottles.cask: Finished in India Pale Ale casks
bottles.about: The first of Glenfiddich's Experimental Series, made with a local craft brewer who seasoned the casks with IPA before they were filled with whisky.

bottles.name: Allt-á-Bhainne
bottles.about: The name means 'burn of milk' in Gaelic. A modern Speyside distillery built mainly for blending, it released this lightly peated single malt under its own name.

bottles.name: Mackmyra Skördetid
bottles.about: Mackmyra was Sweden's first single-malt distillery. Skördetid ('harvest time') was finished in casks that had held Amarone from the Veneto.

bottles.name: The Chita
bottles.palate: Mild, sweet, a hint of mint
bottles.about: A single grain whisky from Suntory's Chita grain distillery on Ise Bay, near Nagoya. It is light and clean, and much of Chita's grain whisky goes into Suntory's blends.

bottles.name: Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve
bottles.about: A smooth Johnnie Walker blend built around Clynelish single malt from the Highlands.

bottles.name: Dalwhinnie
bottles.about: One of the highest and coldest distilleries in Scotland, on the Drumochter Pass. It is one of Diageo's original Classic Malts.

bottles.name: Dufftown-Glenlivet Pure Malt
bottles.about: An older bottling from Dufftown distillery, using the once-common 'Glenlivet' suffix that many Speyside distilleries borrowed.

bottles.name: Loch Lomond The Open
bottles.about: Loch Lomond is the official spirit of The Open golf championship, and a special edition is released for each year's championship. The distillery is known for its unusual straight-necked stills.

bottles.name: Glengoyne
bottles.about: Glengoyne makes unpeated whisky from air-dried barley and runs its stills famously slowly. The distillery sits right on the Highland Line north of Glasgow.

bottles.name: Crawford's Three Star Blended
bottles.about: A classic Scotch blend from the house of Crawford's, originally a Leith whisky firm.

bottles.name: Glenfiddich
bottles.cask: American oak and European oak sherry casks
bottles.about: Founded by William Grant and his family in Dufftown, Glenfiddich helped bring single malt to the world in the 1960s. It remains family-owned.

bottles.name: Glenmorangie Millennium Malt
bottles.about: A 12 year old released to mark the millennium. Glenmorangie, at Tain, has the tallest stills in Scotland.

bottles.name: Singleton of Dufftown
bottles.about: The Singleton is Diageo's name for the single malts of Dufftown, Glendullan and Glen Ord. This one comes from Dufftown in the heart of Speyside.

bottles.name: Johnnie Walker Green Label
bottles.about: A blended malt built around Talisker, Linkwood, Cragganmore and Caol Ila. It was withdrawn in 2012 and brought back by popular demand in 2016.

bottles.name: Timorous Beastie
bottles.about: A Highland blended malt named after the 'wee, sleekit, cow'rin, tim'rous beastie' of Burns's poem To a Mouse. It is part of Douglas Laing's Remarkable Regional Malts.

bottles.name: Aerstone Land Cask
bottles.about: Aerstone comes from Ailsa Bay distillery on the Ayrshire coast. Land Cask is the smoky one, matured inland; its sister Sea Cask is matured near the sea.

bottles.name: Glenmorangie
bottles.about: The Original is Glenmorangie's signature 10 year old. Its very tall stills give a light, elegant spirit.

bottles.name: The Feathery Blended Malt
bottles.about: A blended malt with a golfing theme: the 'feathery' was the leather golf ball stuffed with feathers used before the 1850s.

bottles.name: Tomintoul
bottles.about: Tomintoul calls itself 'the gentle dram'. It is made at one of Speyside's highest distilleries, in the hills near the village of the same name.

bottles.name: Penderyn Madeira
bottles.cask: Ex-bourbon casks, finished in Madeira casks
bottles.about: Penderyn, at the foot of the Brecon Beacons, revived Welsh whisky in 2000 with its Faraday copper still. Madeira-finished malt is its signature style.

bottles.name: Aerstone Sea Cask
bottles.about: Sea Cask is matured in warehouses on the Ayrshire coast for a smooth, gently coastal style. Its sister Land Cask is the smoky one.

bottles.name: Benromach
bottles.about: Benromach in Forres was revived by Gordon & MacPhail in 1998. It aims for the gently peated Speyside style of the 1950s.

bottles.name: Glenlivet Founder's Reserve
bottles.about: A tribute to founder George Smith, who took out one of the first licences under the 1823 Excise Act.

bottles.name: Teeling Small Batch
bottles.about: Teeling opened Dublin's first new distillery in over a century in 2015. The Small Batch is finished in ex-rum casks and bottled without chill filtration.

bottles.name: Tamnavulin Red Wine Cask Edition
bottles.about: Tamnavulin ('mill on the hill') stands beside the River Livet. The Red Wine Cask Edition has been released in several versions with different wine finishes.

bottles.name: Laphroaig
bottles.about: Laphroaig still malts some of its own barley over Islay peat. The 10 year old is the benchmark for big, medicinal Islay smoke and holds a royal warrant.

bottles.name: 808 Single Grain
bottles.about: A single grain Scotch, lighter and sweeter than most malts.

bottles.name: House of Commons No.1
bottles.about: A 12 year old blend bottled for the House of Commons, bearing the portcullis emblem of Parliament.

bottles.name: Glenfiddich Fire & Cane
bottles.cask: Peated and unpeated malt, finished in Latin rum casks
bottles.about: Number four in Glenfiddich's Experimental Series. It marries peated malt with unpeated malt and finishes it in rum casks for a sweet, smoky dram.

bottles.name: Crabbie's Highland
bottles.about: A blend from John Crabbie & Co. of Leith, the firm better known for its ginger wine.

bottles.name: Famous Grouse Famous XV
bottles.notes: Bill McLaren's Famous XV World Rugby Select
bottles.about: A Famous Grouse 15 year old released in tribute to Bill McLaren, the much-loved 'voice of rugby'. It celebrated his all-time Famous XV.

bottles.name: Ben Bracken Islay
bottles.about: An Islay single malt bottled for Lidl; the distillery is not named.

bottles.name: Glen Marnoch Speyside
bottles.about: A Speyside single malt bottled for Aldi; the distillery is not named.

bottles.name: Ardmore Traditional Peated
bottles.about: Ardmore in Aberdeenshire is one of the few Highland distilleries known for peated spirit; Traditional is its signature style. This bottle was distilled in 1995.

bottles.name: Robertsons of Pitlochry Highland
bottles.about: A 12 year old Highland whisky bottled by Robertsons of Pitlochry, a long-established whisky merchant in the Perthshire town.

bottles.name: Tory's Extra (Suntory)
bottles.about: Torys is one of Suntory's oldest everyday brands, launched in 1946 and long associated with Japan's highball bars.

bottles.name: Glen Rosa Pure Malt
bottles.about: An early bottling from Isle of Arran Distillers, the company founded by Harold Currie that opened the island's first legal distillery in over 150 years at Lochranza in 1995. Glen Rosa, named after the glen above Brodick, was the firm's own-label range, released as a blend and this pure malt before Arran's own single malt came of age. It is seldom seen now.

bottles.name: Festival of Architecture Malt
bottles.bottler: Royal Incorporation of Architects in Scotland
bottles.about: A 12 year old malt bottled for the Royal Incorporation of Architects in Scotland to mark a Festival of Architecture.

bottles.name: Tobermory
bottles.about: The only distillery on Mull, in the island's brightly painted harbour town. Its unpeated whisky is bottled as Tobermory; the peated spirit becomes Ledaig.

bottles.name: Ben Bracken Speyside
bottles.about: A Speyside single malt bottled for Lidl; the distillery is not named.

bottles.name: Loch Lomond
bottles.about: Loch Lomond, at Alexandria, makes a wide range of styles using both traditional and unusual straight-necked stills.

bottles.name: A&G Blended Malt
bottles.about: A 21 year old blended malt.
